theme: ES Weekly Patterns Vol.2 — wick patterns + inside/outside
comparison_to_nq: Hammer pattern works on both: ES 60.13% vs NQ 60.50%. KEY DIFFERENCE: Shooting star red-next ES 59.74% vs NQ 51.61%. Shooting stars actually WORK on ES (10pp edge) but NOT on NQ (essentially coin flip). The bullish-drift asymmetry that suppresses bearish reversal patterns on NQ is weaker on ES — bearish reversal patterns are tradeable on ES.
